items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Andrew Morgan, Andrew Morgan worked up there a long time.

ctx.x: I'm trying to remember who was at Thump and Manny's and the Lyon Centers and different places. Used to see you uptown. Andy. Andy? Howard. Sometimes Andrew Morgan too.
Andrew Morgan, Andrew Morgan worked up there a long time. Yeah.
Do you have a guitar or a piano or what?
